div.div:
con-grātŭlor , ātus, āri,
I.v. dep., to wish joy, to congratulate (very rare; not in Cic.); absol.: “dona quid cessant mihi Conferre omnes congratulantes, qui pugnavi fortiter,” Plaut. Men. 1, 2, 21 Brix; Gell. 12, 1, 4; Vulg. 2 Reg. 8, 10.—With dat. pers., Vulg. Ruth, 4, 17; cf. Porc. Latro, Decl. in Catil. 36.—Alicui de aliquā re, Vulg. Tob. 11, 20.—With acc. and inf., Liv. 3, 54, 7.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
